mission.zh: 收集高价值的一手标准、制作复盘、玩家体验、商业发行与可授权素材，不与开源代码项目混为一谈。
mission.en: Track first-party standards, postmortems, player experience, distribution and licensed assets separately from open-source repositories.

sources.name: GDC Vault

summary.zh: 收集一线游戏开发团队的技术分享、设计取舍与制作复盘，区分可公开观看和订阅内容。
summary.en: Talks and postmortems from production game teams; check free versus subscription access.

learning.zh: 挑选真正解释机制和失败教训的演讲，提炼实验假设，不转载付费音视频。
learning.en: Extract testable production lessons; do not redistribute subscriber videos.

sources.rights_note: Conference content is copyrighted; link to sessions, do not rehost.

sources.name: Game Developer Postmortems

summary.zh: 按设计、技术与制作结果阅读开发者复盘，特别关注失败原因和迭代转折点。
summary.en: Industry postmortems covering design choices, development outcomes and failures.

learning.zh: 将假设、实际结果和反例分类成游戏可复用的设计判断。
learning.en: Convert assumptions, outcomes and counterexamples into design review notes.

sources.rights_note: Copyright retained by writers and publisher; links and original summaries only.

sources.name: IGDA Developer Satisfaction Survey

summary.zh: 通过协会开发者调查研究行业开发条件与人员生态，不将从业者调查误当玩家偏好。
summary.en: Developer survey on working conditions and industry demographics, not player preferences.

learning.zh: 建立开发团队能力与风险研究基线，并保留报告统计口径。
learning.en: Keep report methodology and sampling limits when interpreting industry capacity.

sources.rights_note: Published research; follow report citation and reuse terms.

sources.name: Steamworks UTM Analytics

summary.zh: 官方说明商店访问、可信访问及愿望单或购买等归因转化的口径和限制。
summary.en: Official definitions for campaign visits, trusted traffic and attributed wishlists or sales.

learning.zh: 为推广设计来源参数、去机器人流量和转化漏斗；不混淆访客与玩家。
learning.en: Design campaign funnels, bot filters and conversion tracking without equating visits to players.

sources.rights_note: Official docs; Steam store data is permissioned and aggregate, not public player logs.

sources.name: itch.io Creator Documentation

summary.zh: 讲述项目页面、标签、发布更新与创作者后台浏览/下载/购买分析。
summary.en: Official creator guide for publishing, tags and dashboard views/download/sales metrics.

learning.zh: 研究试玩页面 A/B 展示和作品更新节奏；实际后台数据必须有账号权限。
learning.en: Study play-page presentation and update cadence; private creator analytics need authorization.

sources.rights_note: Public guide; account analytics and third-party games are not public data.

sources.name: Game Accessibility Guidelines

summary.zh: 由开发者与无障碍专业人员整理的基础、进阶和高级游戏可访问性建议。
summary.en: Practical game accessibility guidance organized by effort and complexity.

learning.zh: 建立手柄、字幕、颜色、输入重映射和认知负担的体验验收计划。
learning.en: Test subtitles, color, remapping, controllers and cognitive load in gameplay.

sources.rights_note: Guidance copyrighted by creators; original checklists allowed with attribution.

sources.name: W3C WCAG 2.2

summary.zh: W3C 网页可访问性标准，可用于游戏平台导航、账户、购买和游戏外层 UI。
summary.en: W3C accessibility standard for web navigation, controls and platform shell.

learning.zh: 独立评估焦点、对比度、输入与键盘导航，不能因自动通过就声称合规。
learning.en: Check focus, contrast, keyboard and pointer interactions beyond automated checks.

sources.rights_note: W3C technical standard; follow W3C document license.

sources.name: MDN Gamepad API

summary.zh: 浏览器手柄输入与事件接口说明，涉及设备连接、按键和轴状态。
summary.en: Browser game-controller connection, button and axis API reference.

learning.zh: 建立 PC 手柄与移动触控分开的输入适配层，验证热插拔和映射。
learning.en: Design gamepad input adapter and test hotplug, mapping and fallback.

sources.rights_note: MDN documentation; API compatibility varies by browser/device.

sources.name: Khronos glTF Specification

summary.zh: glTF 2.0 数据规范，用于确认网格、材质、动画和扩展的语义及合法性。
summary.en: Authoritative glTF 2.0 schema and semantics for meshes, materials and animation.

learning.zh: 让结构验证、材质引用和扩展处理建立在规范而非猜测上。
learning.en: Build asset validation and extension handling on the actual specification.

sources.rights_note: Standard text and external models have separate rights.

sources.name: Khronos KTX Artist Guide

summary.zh: 官方材质师指南区分 ETC1S、UASTC 及颜色与数据纹理的压缩策略。
summary.en: Artist-oriented KTX2 guidance explaining codec choice for color and data textures.

learning.zh: 按法线、粗糙度、颜色分配压缩参数，实际测显存、模糊和压缩瑕疵。
learning.en: Tune KTX codecs by map role and test memory and visible artifacts.

sources.rights_note: Khronos guide; sample images and tools retain their own license.

sources.name: Khronos glTF Sample Assets

summary.zh: 包含材质、扩展、动画与模型变体的可搜索验证素材库，每个模型授权不同。
summary.en: Searchable glTF validation scenes covering materials, extensions and animation.

learning.zh: 从素材库选能自动验收的参考模型，但逐个核查授权及对应源文件。
learning.en: Use reference fixtures for importer QA; audit every model's individual rights.

sources.rights_note: Per-asset licenses vary; not a blanket free-commercial asset library.

sources.name: W3C WebGPU Specification

summary.zh: 浏览器 GPU 绘图与计算、缓冲区、管线、查询及安全行为的正式规范。
summary.en: W3C WebGPU API specification for pipelines, buffers, queries and security.

learning.zh: 设计双后端一致性与设备丢失测试，区分规范与浏览器实现差异。
learning.en: Test device loss and WebGL fallback against spec and real implementations.

sources.rights_note: Technical standard; browser availability/feature flags vary.

sources.name: Poly Haven License

summary.zh: 官方说明 HDRI、材质和 3D 模型资产 CC0，同时明确网站其他内容与 API 条款的边界。
summary.en: Official CC0 scope for site assets, distinguished from site content and API terms.

learning.zh: 建立可靠的商用素材候选池，记录每件作品来源并尊重 API 使用条款。
learning.en: Source potential commercial assets while respecting per-item provenance and API terms.

sources.rights_note: CC0 applies to listed assets; site branding, site content and API terms are separate.

sources.name: ambientCG License

summary.zh: 官方文档声明素材以 CC0 许可提供，支持游戏内使用和二次加工。
summary.en: Official ambientCG CC0 asset policy covering materials and models.

learning.zh: 为不同环境材质收集真实 PBR 对照，避免依赖生成式模型凭空猜贴图。
learning.en: Collect real PBR reference materials with source metadata for environment art.

sources.rights_note: Downloadable assets CC0; individual project context and site API terms still matter.

sources.name: Kenney Asset Use FAQ

summary.zh: 官方说明资产页面的素材采用 CC0 商用许可，但 Logo 不是可自由复用资产。
summary.en: Kenney's official FAQ confirms CC0 game assets with separate logo rights.

learning.zh: 用可溯源图形和音效做原创测试原型，保留版本与资产包说明。
learning.en: Use traceable art/audio packs in test scenes, preserving package versions.

sources.rights_note: Game assets on asset pages CC0; logos and other site materials are not.

sources.name: WebSplatter ACM Multimedia 2026

summary.zh: WebGPU 原生 3DGS 跨架构渲染研究，作者报告多设备性能和画质测试。
summary.en: WebGPU-native splat rendering paper with author-reported cross-device evaluation.

learning.zh: 研究排序避免死锁和透明度性能，不将论文速度比视作本地实测。
learning.en: Study sort synchronization and opacity pipeline; benchmark author claims independently.

sources.rights_note: Research content attributed to authors; code and demo assets require separate licenses.

sources.name: HY3D-Bench 2026

summary.zh: 三维生成数据集和结构化部件标注方向的研究，用于建立资产质量考题。
summary.en: 3D generation benchmark emphasizing curated assets and part-level decomposition.

learning.zh: 借鉴合成数据和可拆分部件的评价思路；先核对实际可公开下载的授权。
learning.en: Adapt part-level evaluation concepts; verify actual benchmark data distribution rights.

sources.rights_note: Research paper is not a blanket dataset reuse license.

sources.name: GDC Procedural Generation Talks

summary.zh: 集中研究程序化关卡、地形与叙事生成的实际项目经验及失败记录。
summary.en: GDC archive for procedural generation presentations and lessons.

learning.zh: 以可玩的地图连通性和节奏为验收目标，不只生成看起来复杂的图案。
learning.en: Validate generated levels for reachability and pacing, not visual novelty alone.

sources.rights_note: GDC sessions may be paywalled/copyrighted; reference only.
